items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bill Ronald was on too, huh? ... [INTERVIEWEE] That never did me to him.

ctx.x: And guitar, four string guitar. And did he ever change? Did he play something else later? He went to six-meg guitar just about the time I joined the Massingale band. I remember he was in Whirlines that day. He told me the banks were going to close the next day left town. And he went to bass fiddle for maybe 15 years later.
Yeah, I was thinking he played with him. But he didn't play too much bass. He did. He did. He did. Bill Ronald was on too, huh? I'm looking at your scrapbook, so...
That never did me to him. Yeah, this Al Roles.
